sample_unit: clinician-authored clinical scenarios (184 rubric criteria; 552 graded criteria)

links.outcome: Rubric pass rates on expert-authored clinical reasoning tasks, by criterion weight
links.effect: Mean rubric pass rates were 0.47 (Claude), 0.38 (GPT), 0.37 (Gemini); critical weight-5 criteria passed at only 32.4-41.7% versus 80-90% for weight-1 criteria; 55 of 108 critical criteria satisfied by no model.
links.quote: The central finding is an inversion of clinical priority: the highest-weighted (weight-5, critical) criteria passed at only 32.4-41.7%, while low-stakes weight-1 criteria passed at 80-90%.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM autoraters to reproduce expert rubric grading (92.8-94.6% agreement on 552 criteria)
Atomic weighted MECE rubrics authored from clinician golden answers for open-ended clinical evaluation

screen.reason: Evaluates frontier LLMs on expert-authored clinical reasoning tasks using a rubric-based benchmarking pipeline, but does not test a specific deployment practice or operational safeguard.
